rationale: The fix-up derives an includesToolOutputs flag (includeToolOutputs && format is docx/pdf) and, when true, appends `_with_tool_outputs` to the filename before the extension, so a with-tool-outputs export and the default export of the same conversation/format now resolve to distinct filenames — resolving CR-001, the sole prior blocking finding. Confirmed against current source (src/store/chats.ts:466-478) and the updated test assertions (src/store/__tests__/chats.export.test.ts:88,95), including that the json/non-docx-pdf path still gets no suffix. No other blocking findings existed in the prior verdict to verify; the pre-existing currentChat-falsy gap remains deferred and out of this round's scope.

findings.title: Export filename ignores tool-outputs variant
findings.problem: exportChat builds the download filename as `${name}.${format}` regardless of includeToolOutputs, so a with-tool-outputs export and a default export of the same conversation and format resolve to the identical filename.
findings.impact: A user who downloads both variants in one session gets indistinguishable files on disk (browser auto-rename or overwrite), defeating the point of offering the two variants this change introduces.
findings.recommendation: Append a suffix (e.g. `_with_tool_outputs`) to `name` when includeToolOutputs is true, before building the filename passed to api.downloadFileStream.

finding_status.notes: chats.ts now computes includesToolOutputs = Boolean(includeToolOutputs) && format is docx/pdf, and builds fileName as `${name}_with_tool_outputs.${format}` when true, else `${name}.${format}`. Confirmed at chats.ts:470-472 and in updated test assertions asserting 'Notes_with_tool_outputs.docx'/'.pdf' for the true case and unchanged 'Notes.json' for the json/true case.
